parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: EndTimeQuery
parameters.description: The timestamp when the root task ends. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Settings for the number of client tasks on each page in a paged query. Default value: **20**, which indicates that each page contains 20 client tasks.

parameters.name: RootTaskId
parameters.description:
The root task ID.
> **TaskType** and **RootTaskId** cannot both be empty.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The node source. Valid values include but are not limited to:
- **schedule**: automatic scheduling of vulnerability scanning
- **console**: one-click detection from the vulnerability scanning console

parameters.name: StartTimeQuery
parameters.description: The timestamp when the root task starts. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:
- **VUL\_CHECK\_TASK**: vulnerability scanning node
- **CLIENT\_PROBLEM\_CHECK**: client node
- **CLIENT\_DEV\_OPS**: cloud O&M node
- **ASSET\_SECURITY\_CHECK**: asset information collection node
- **ASSET\_REFRESH\_HOST**: host asset synchronization node
> **TaskType** and **RootTaskId** cannot both be empty.
